repo.description:
A highly experimental app that plays with persistent, cross-app, cross-device identity over the Veilid network. Data is stored among peers, not servers. Currently supporting cross-device text and Markdown notes, contacts, invitations, extremely basic chat. Notes and Notebooks can be shared and co-edited.

Future milestones include things like folder sync among devices / contacts, OS contact list integrations, todo list, and calendar / event / scheduling. All stored and shared in the digital commons.

repo.name: prism
repo.description: PRISM (Probing Relativistic effects In Simulated Maps) is a public pipeline for modelling the relativistic effects imprinted on the large-scale structure of the Universe. From a single N-body light cone, it applies all first-order relativistic corrections, gravitational redshift, Doppler terms, lensing, and the integrated Sachs–Wolfe effect, as a post-processing layer, producing internally consistent relativistic galaxy catalogues together with weak-lensing, CMB-lensing, and ISW maps. Because all tracers share the same underlying realisation, PRISM is a natural engine for studying their cross-correlations and for building the large mock ensembles needed for covariance estimation and simulation-based inference, at a small fraction of the cost of a fully relativistic N-body simulation.
